title: Death of the Novel(ty): Beyond n-Gram Novelty as a Metric for Textual Creativity

scope.included: 两开放模型与人类小说段落的表达创造性、n-gram新颖度效度；包含专家评价和层级分析。
scope.excluded: 排除LoRA/API训练评分器及小样本前沿模型作为主依据。
scope.study_summary: 两开放模型生成小说段落，专业作者从新颖、语义通顺和语境恰当三方面评价表达，检验n-gram新颖度的测量效度。
scope.scope_basis: 冻结交付的最终reason/review及qualification_scope；候选字段仅作定位，事实定向核原文

reading.limits: 逐篇核查已纳入研究单元及其直接支撑方法，引用段落实际读取；未声称全篇全部实验重新阅读或验收。

facts.description: 专家对预高亮表达评语义通顺、语境恰当和新颖，也可追加创造表达；50人类种子段落分别给两模型各25段生成，100段按5人类+5AI分批、每批3评者。

in Figure 2, where the pop-up window displays the annotation of a pre-highlighted expression, and
in green the annotator highlighted a creative expression.
R ECRUITMENT We recruit professional writers (n = 26) via listservs of top Master of Fine Arts
writing programs in the US, as well as published writers with a Masters in English Writing or
Literature through the Upwork platform. Each annotator first underwent training on at least one
passage during which any instruction misunderstandings were corrected. Annotators were paid ≈
100 USD per annotated batch of 10 passages, which took approximately 2–3 hours.
A NNOTATION The fiction domain is best suited for evaluating textual creativity, as it does not im-
pose factuality constraints unlike technical or journalistic writing, and is less subjective in creativity
evaluation than poetry (Kaufman et al., 2008; 2009). Hence, for seed human data we collect 50
passages of ≈ 400 words each from fiction published in the New Yorker.5 We use fully open-source
(both weights and training data) LLMs: OLMo (7B) (Groeneveld et al., 2024) and OLMo-2 (32B)
(Team OLMo et al., 2025) to generate LLM passages, considering both the older and the improved,
larger models to understand whether progress in language modeling and benchmark performance
led to improvements in writing quality. The passages were chosen such that they are not present in
the corresponding open-source LLM training corpora (see Appendix A.2). We assign each model
25 passages from the human sample (seed passages), and prompt them to generate a similar length
passage based on the content obtained from the summary of the human text (see details in Appendix
C.2). To ensure reasonable completion time for each annotator task, we divide the total 100 passages
into 10 batches of 10 passages each, containing 5 human and 5 AI passages. Three annotators are
assigned per batch. To gauge the ceiling LLM performance, we conduct a smaller-scale follow-up
study6 on 2 frontier models: GPT-5 and Claude 4.1, each generating 5 passages to make up one
additional batch of 10 texts assigned to 4 randomly selected annotators from our pool.

facts.description: 用对应训练语料backoff n-gram概率的perplexity作新颖度代理，创造性定义为通顺、语境恰当且新颖同时满足；logistic模型含评分者与种子段落层级项。

M ODELING Annotation of textual creativity is inherently subjective. To account for annotator vari-
ation as well as other confounding factors (topic of the passage, generation model), we turn to
hierarchical/multilevel modeling (Gelman & Hill, 2007) commonly used to handle nested data in
behavioral and social sciences (Baayen et al., 2008; Yarkoni, 2022; Kaufmann et al., 2025) and
account for confounders in language model evaluation (Lampinen et al., 2022). Since our target
variables are binary judgments of sensicality, pragmaticality, and perceived novelty, we fit logistic
regression models. For instance, to model the relationship between n-gram novelty (measured by
perplexity) and creativity, we fit the following model for the probability of the expression being

facts.description: 线性模型预处理移除两段被发现存在于OLMo训练集的段落，并移除37个不同时间perplexity估计不稳定的表达。

evidence.quote:
Due to instability of the infinigram API, we intially were not able to detect two passages as part of
the OLMo pretraining data (IDs 14520 and 7644). We therefore removed those passages at the pre-
processing stage for the linear models, which did not affect the outcomes of the research questions.
In addition, we filter out 37 unique expressions that received varying perplexity estimates from the
infinigram API due to being computed at different times.

infinigram API due to being computed at different times.

facts.description: 温度1生成，过长按段截短，长度偏差过大或明显偏离提示时重新生成；摘要主题经人工检查。

evidence.quote:
We sample with temperature = 1 and truncate the output by paragraphs if they were too long,
regenerating if they were too short (not within 10% of the original passage). For summaries, we
manually ensured the overall topic was consistent with the passage (in 2-3 rare cases, the summaries
were completely off-topic). For stories, we manually examined the outputs and regenerated the story
in case of an output that did not at all adhere to the prompt (for example, sometimes OLMo model
would generate a a play script instead of a passage, and once the model generated a story fully in
Spanish).

demands.need: 用专家三维判定检验n-gram新颖度能否代表创造性。

matches.reason: 三维判断与perplexity是实际测量结果。
创造性要求新颖、通顺与语境恰当同时满足。
n-gram罕见不自动等于有意义的创造性。

demands.need: 区分表达、段落与评分者，使用层级模型处理共享材料与评分差异。

matches.reason: 多条注释和同段表达不是独立生成次数。
模型纳入评分者与种子段落的层级随机项。
种子段落属于材料随机因素。

demands.need: 记录训练重叠排除、计量不稳定排除和生成筛选规则。

matches.function: 测试集污染 / 数据泄漏
matches.reason: 发现训练语料重叠后排除，直接处理污染风险。
不稳定计量与筛后样本影响统计解释。

limitations: 预高亮提高高新颖表达被评价的机会；重新生成次数未完整报告；不将PPL相关解释成随机操纵新颖度的因果效果。
